claims: Lender-paid commission is the most common model for how a mortgage broker gets paid.
In the lender-paid commission model, the lender pays the broker 1%–2% of the total loan principal.
It is illegal for brokers to receive commissions from both the borrower and the lender on the same transaction.
Mortgage brokers must pass tests and obtain a license through the Nationwide Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) to operate legally.
